This section (labelled "Section 1.") is part of EO 13278 of December 11, 2002, the order that established the President's Commission on the United States Postal Service. Section 6(b) of the order provides: "(b) The Commission shall terminate 30 days after submitting its report 
and in no event later than August 30, 2003." The outer date is a fixed calendar limit, so the Commission (and with it every provision of the order that establishes, staffs, directs or reports from the Commission) ended no later than August 30, 2003, recorded inclusive of that day; the alternative exclusive reading is that the order ended when that day began. The report-relative part of the sentence could have ended the Commission earlier, but the date of the report is not held in any source in the repository, so it is disclosed as an earlier possibility and not recorded. Section 3 of EO 13316 of September 17, 2003 later revoked the order by number (effective September 30, 2003) among orders that established committees described there as terminated or with completed work; that is a later event, not the first end.
